description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's ERFC kernel on an epsilon-ladder of runs just below x = 4 (stage-deviation unwrapping for the [0.5, 4] rational): 8,192 consecutive doubles from x0 = 4*(1-eps), eps = 2^-24, 2^-22, ..., 2^-4. Runs: x0=3.75 n=8192 row=1. B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)).
